producer.name: performance_classification.py
limits: This record binds the classification and declared identity of one measurement campaign; it executes nothing.
It does not establish that the cited campaign occurred as described; the campaign receipt is the record of that.
It does not turn a virtualised-court ratio into a frontier result, and it measures no constant-time property.
A green validation is a statement about claim form, not about the truth of the measurement.
The ratios are bound to this candidate's DSO digest and are not comparable to any figure published at another digest, including PFP-0 and PFP-1.

threat_model.statement: Private exponents, RSA private operands and ECDSA nonces and keys are SECRET_DATA; moduli and bases are public. The measured operations must not branch, address or exit early on secret values. This record binds the measurement; the timing obligations T23, T24 and T29 remain open and nothing here discharges them.
threat_model.observation_model: wall-clock latency on a virtualised host; no PMU, no cache or branch counters, no frequency, turbo or SMT control

venue.description: virtualised court container openssl-rs-court-tools:1 on a 13th Gen Intel Core i9-13900K, kernel 7.3.5-2-cachyos, pinned to CPU 1 with taskset; the PMU probe records hypervisor_present=1, cpuid.0A num_general_counters=0, cpu_event_source=absent and perf stat -e cycles '<not supported>'

open.description: Secret ownership does not propagate through the arithmetic itself; the transfer window and 17 inversion intermediates at secret-dependent width remain open.
The constant-time inversion's scratch storage and the operands' normalised limb-count metadata remain the recorded residual.
The ECDSA per-signature allocation blow-up and the related fixed-width workspace residual remain open.
The venue exposes no PMU and has no frequency, turbo, SMT or isolation control; every row is a SCOPED_OBSERVATION and no frontier, lead or competitive claim is made.

No differential court was run at candidate DSO 6d7e282d... in this campaign; the harness itself compares CHECK lines and cross-signs in both directions, which is correctness evidence inside one instrument, not the programme's differential court.

binary_branch_audit.py was attempted at this digest and exited 1: the inventory target mod_exp_core_consttime_from_parts is absent from the built DSO (it is inlined into mod_exp_core_consttime_from_parts_prepared), so 1 of 7 targets was refused and the report is not a gate result.
AWS-LC, BoringSSL, rustls and wolfSSL were not executed; their rows are UNAVAILABLE or NOT_APPLICABLE, never losses.
Throughput, tail latency, parallel scaling, memory, energy, startup and L1/L2/L4/L5 behaviour are outside this record.
The benchmarked distribution DSO is not committed; the digest and build-id are tracked and the bytes must be rebuilt from 2e9c4c5cf by the recorded recipe.
